question: What measure is declared even though that too is not to be done, with tolerance stated at the linga tip?
premises: That also is said not to be done.
At the linga tip it is to be tolerated.
inference: Even that is not to be done, yet a measure is declared and at the linga tip some tolerance is stated.
uncertainties: Exact force of liṅgāgrekṣantavyaṃ (tolerated/looked at) is uncertain.
plain_english: That too is not to be done; at the tip of the liṅga it is to be tolerated—such a measure is declared.
